title: Typical approximation with prescribed Fourier support
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $\mathcal{F}$ be a nonempty family of subsets of $[n]$. Suppose $0<\varepsilon<1$ and $\left(1-\varepsilon^2/(6n)\right)2^n\le |\mathcal{F}|$. For a uniformly chosen function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, the probability that there is no real-valued function $q$ whose Fourier coefficients vanish outside $\mathcal{F}$ and which satisfies $|f(x)-q(x)|<\varepsilon$ at every input $x$ is at most $2^{-n}$.
